question: The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) held its 54th meeting from 7 to 9 April 2025 under whose Chairmanship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Sanjay Malhotra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **54th meeting** of the **Monetary Policy Committee (MPC)** was conducted over three days, specifically from **7 to 9 April 2025**.
 
• The meeting was held under the **Chairmanship** of **Shri Sanjay Malhotra**, who serves as the **Governor** of the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** during this period.
 
• The primary objective of this **MPC** meeting was to deliberate on the prevailing **macroeconomic situation** and determine the **Policy Repo Rate** required to maintain price stability.
 
• The **MPC** is a statutory body responsible for fixing the benchmark interest rates in **India**, ensuring that **inflation** remains within the target range while supporting economic growth.
 
• Decisions within the committee are made through a **majority vote** among its **six members**, and the **Governor** holds the **casting vote** in the event of a tie.
